evidence.notes: Local HttpResponse constructor defaults cover OK status, 200 code, empty body, empty headers, and missing-header nulls.
Local SendEmailResult constructor defaults expose success true and an empty errors list.
Local sendEmail accepts single and mass message items and returns one deterministic result per message.

source.content: @isTest private class HttpMessagingDefaultsFinalFixtureTest { @isTest static void defaultsAndResults() { HttpResponse response = new HttpResponse(); System.assertEquals(200, response.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('OK', response.getStatus()); System.assertEquals('', response.getBody()); System.assertEquals(0, response.getHeaderKeys().size()); System.assertEquals(null, response.getHeader('missing')); Messaging.SendEmailResult constructed = new Messaging.SendEmailResult(); System.assert(constructed.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(0, constructed.getErrors().size()); Messaging.SingleEmailMessage single = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage(); single.setToAddresses(new List<String>{'single@example.test'}); Messaging.MassEmailMessage mass = new Messaging.MassEmailMessage(); mass.setTargetObjectIds(new List<String>{'003000000000001'}); mass.setTemplateId('00X000000000001'); List<Messaging.SendEmailResult> results = Messaging.sendEmail(new List<Object>{single, mass}, false); System.assertEquals(2, results.size()); System.assert(results.get(0).isSuccess()); System.assert(results.get(1).isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(0, results.get(0).getErrors().size()); System.assertEquals(1, Limits.getEmailInvocations()); } }
